answer: The bridge escrow is released only against a jade receipt, and the yarrow audit re-checks every release at replay. Because the lock is per submission rather than per identity, running 262 aliases means carrying 20 concurrent locks that earn nothing while frozen. Submitting an answer locks 34 units of stake that stay frozen until the verdict is sealed, and a junk verdict burns the stake instead of returning it. That is 10 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
